profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Washington Student Achievement Council (WSAC)
profile.summary:
Anthony uniquely combines fifteen years of experience in education with three years of experience in software engineering.

Educational Experience: math and computer science instruction, instructional coaching, curriculum development, and school administration

Software Engineering Experience: database-driven website development, development of a large distributed Java-based application for network security administration, and full product development management

positions.title: Director
positions.description: The Director position includes most of the responsibilities associated with a Head of School, School Principal, and Superintendent.

positions.title: Assistant Director
positions.description: My responsibilities include managing all schedules within the school (bell schedules, master schedules, event coordination, etc.), monitoring and lead curriculum development efforts throughout the school (including planning and leading professional development, managing the course catalog and related documents), and additional duties as assigned (including student and teacher discipline, hiring and interviewing).

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description: My responsiblilties including teaching high school mathematics and computer science courses. This included AP Calculus AB, AP Computer Science A, Precalculus, Algebra 2, and Algebra 1.

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description:
Six years as a high school teacher: AP Calculus, AP Computer Science A, Algebra, Geometry.
Two years as a Consultant Teacher writing curriculum and coaching teachers.

positions.title: Director Of Product Development
positions.description: Product Development, Specification Writing, Software Engineering Team Lead for Database and Data Storage.

positions.title: Web Designer / Developer
positions.description: Built internal news database for pushing content to six public media websites.
